notes.title: v1.13 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h3]도박 : 경마[/h3]
[list]
[*]이제 경마장의 "일러스트레이터"에게서 치트 "미소녀 육상대회"를 활성화 할 수 있게 되었습니다.
[/list]

[h3]버그 수정[/h3]
[list]
[*]DmD 「VIP 기프트」를 사용한 뒤 콜로세움에 처음 들어갔을때 코스트가 초기화되던 버그를 수정했습니다.
[*]DmD 카드게임 챔피언 뱃지를 여러번 얻을 수 있는 버그를 수정했습니다.
[*]특정 상황에서 시간이 넘어가지 않고 반복되는 버그를 수정했습니다.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.12 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h3]Gambling: Enhancing Weapons[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42532796/251ad97cbb76ff7439e2bbd5337457cb8ccd99d0.png[/img][h3]
Buy/sell prices for all weapons have increased by 1.5 times.

[h3]Bug fix[/h3]
[list][*]Fixed a bug where wallet money was not consumed when purchasing a “random box” for an online game.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.11 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h3]Contents: pretty girl racing[/h3]
Some characters' lines have been slightly modified.

[h3] Gamble: Ace Breaker[/h3]
Multiplier added per ace reduced from 1x to 0.7x.
In addition, the multiplier of "Ace Breaker", which destroys an ace with a joker, is reduced from 3x to 2.1x.

[h3]bug fixes[/h3]
[list][*]Fixed a bug where the "bankruptcy" cheat was not applied properly in Cheat Engine.
[*]Fixed a bug where the amount was displayed incorrectly in the Gambler's Treasure Chest.
[*]Fixed a bug where Acebreaker's multiplier increased each time the game progressed.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.1 Patch Note
notes.content:
[h3]System: Cheat Engine[/h3]
"Cheat Codes" obtained after endings can now be entered in-game as well.
"Cheat Engine" is activated by entering any cheat code after starting a new game, and it can be checked on the in-game PC.



[h3] New Unearned Income: Cryptocurrency Mining[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42532796/f75e318a367830f342ccf76b9cdab4f9730c7cee.png[/img]

Now, "Cryptocurrency mining" is added as unearned income.
Buy a graphics card, etc. at the shopping mall and mine Cryptocurrency. (Graphic cards are consumables.)



[h3]New Content: Shopping Mall[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42532796/0162628242366cc2a7ce25f9f605926f7bdbd39c.png[/img]

Now you don't have to go outside for an energy drink.
You can easily purchase various items such as graphics cards, potions, DmD card packs, and lottery tickets with your PC.



[h3]Contents: Kawaii Race[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42532796/8dbcd51680c6151d76ca7d0cb0a3d086c9de13f8.png[/img]

When naming a character, a major upgrade has been applied to the cheat code that is activated by naming "Horse", "Kawaii"!

(The effects written below are only activated for the "Kawaii Race" only.)
[list]
[*]Each horse's unique illustration is added.
[*]During a match, when a horse uses a skill, a cut-in will appear.
[*]You can chat casually with the winning horse in the racecourse lounge.
[/list]



[h3] Gambling: Cups and Balls[/h3]
Now, instead of actually shuffling the cards (previously it used to be random), the speed of shuffling the cards is increased.


[h3] Gambling: Poker[/h3]
The price of chips increases from ₩1,000 to ₩5,000 each.


[h3]bug fixes[/h3]
[list][*]Fixed a bug where pressing certain options during horse racing would move you to an odd location.
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented some slot machines from working.
[*]Fixed a time warping bug that occurred when sleeping in bed or when time stopped.[/list]

notes.title: v1.03 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h3]Gambling: Random Box[/h3]
The price fluctuation rate of Heroic/Legendary items has been reduced.
[list][*] Heroic: ₩20,000~₩70,000 → ₩20,000~₩40,000
[*] Legend: ₩60,000~₩120,000 → ₩50,000~₩100,000[/list]
[h3]Gambling: Cryptocurrency[/h3]
Hourly variable amount of MVC and RTC has been reduced by ₩100. Now time doesn't pass while you're watching headline news.


[h3]Gambling: Blackjack [/h3]
From now on, 40 minutes of in-game time will flow at the end of every cycle(5 games). In return, win/lose multiplier changed from +0.5/-0.5 to +0.6/-0.4.


[h3]Gambling: Poker[/h3]
30 minutes of in-game time will flow after every game.


[h3]Gambling: Roulette[/h3]
From now on, 30 minutes of in-game time will flow after every game. In return, the multipliers of all options have been slightly increased.

[h3]Hardcore(+2022-11-09)[/h3]
[list][*]Debt increased from ₩750,000,000 (₩7.5B) to ₩10,000,000,000 (₩10B).
[*]Instead, the interest multiplier has been reduced from 12% (compounded) to 2.5% (compounded).
[*]Also, the "Gambler" bonus is applied by default in Hardcore mode.[/list]


[h3]Minigame: DmD card game[/h3]
[list][*]Angra Mainyu's attack power has been reduced from 5 to 3.
[*]Spenta Mainyu's HP decreased from 5 to 3.
[*] Spirit King Oberon's attack power has been reduced from 3 to 2.[/list]
[h3]QoL Patches[/h3]
[list][*]Time won't pass when you are listening to an explanation of gambling.
[*]If HP becomes 0 while playing Blackjack/Poker/Roulette, you'll survive without dying for once.[/list]
[h3]Fix bugs[/h3]
[list][*]Fixed a bug where the bet amount was deducted twice if you lose in High & Low.
[*]Fixed a time-twisting bug that occured when sleeping in bed or when time stops.[/list]

notes.title: v1.02 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h3] Gambling: Random Box [/h3]
[list][*] The price of the box has been changed from "₩20,000" to "₩15,000 to ₩40,000".
[*] The number of items that can be possessed has been changed.
[list][*] Normal : 300 → 200
[*] Rare: 200 → 100
[*] Heroes: 150 → 70
[*] Legendary: 100 → 50[/list][/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed a bug where skills were not cast in horse racing.
[*] Fixed a bug where the horse moved to a strange location at the end of the race.
[*] Fixed a bug where Blackjack's magnification was not applied properly.[/list]

notes.title: v1.01 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Minor bugs and typographical errors have been fixed.
[*] Fixed a problem with the English translation.[/list]
